newsitem.title: USA: NYS Authority approves $209 mln of bond sales.
newsitem.headline: NYS Authority approves $209 mln of bond sales.

text.p: New York State Public Authorities Control Board has approved nearly $209 million of bond sales for various projects, with the lion's share -- $185 million -- earmarked for New York Mortgage Agency.
Mortgage Agency plans to sell up to $75 million of refunding bonds and as much as $100 million of new money bonds, according to the Authority's documents, which approved the sales on Wednesday.
No details about when or how the bonds would be brought to market were immediately available.

Dormitory Authority got approval for tktk issues of bonds, a $10.3 million offering for Wesley Health Care Center, a $7.2 million sale for Arden Hill Life Care Center, and a $5 million one for CAMBA Primary Health Care Center. A $1.2 million project was approved for Hotel Washington Apartments.
And the Authority also approved up to $30.4 million of taxable commercial paper for Dormitory Authority.
